integrity: Derivation from cyclic moment identities; integer ambiguity independently checked; fixed-seed numerical checks are ancillary, not a proof of genericity.
scientific_limitations: Almost-everywhere uniqueness only for degree at most two on the three cube roots; explicit nongeneric ambiguity; no exceptional-stratum classification, robustness bound, or higher-degree statement.
title: Sharp three-point sampling for almost-everywhere quadratic polynomial phase retrieval
